name: Sourcing agent — 8-case golden set (D34 locale spread)
description: Phase 3 skeleton golden set per sourcing.spec.md §7. The full 80-case set (20 per locale per sourcing.spec.md §7) lands in tests/golden/sourcing/{ko-skincare,en-fitness,ja-cafe,zh-tech}.json during Phase 4 calibration. Each case captures the synthesised final response — the agent's real tool sequence (rapidapi.tiktok_search × 2-4, blacklist.check × 1, vector_search.creator × 1) lands when ADK FunctionTools are wired (Phase 4 / BN-11 follow-up).

phase_3_boundary_notes: candidates[] are synthesised fixtures, not live RapidAPI hits.
queriesUsed[] are the strings the agent *would* run; Phase 4 records the actual tool invocation log.
coverageNote intentionally varies tone (comfortable / tight / saturation) to seed the eval rubric.
